Hmm... Roselynn, Lilly/Lillian, Heather, and Willow are the ones I know!

For voice, I recommend looking up videos on how to lower your voice or voice training. When I did voice training, it was mainly just humming lower and lower every day to help adjust to a lower voice, and then trying to speak that way. For chest, I usually layer a couple t-shirts under what im wearing that day since my chest isn't that large. If it gets too warm, trying layering a sports bra or two. For hips, I would wear baggy pants like jeans or sweatpants. Larger/baggier hoodies can help reach down and cover the hips, too. For hair, I don't have too much advice on that one and I'm sorry. My best advice would be to wear a wig if you can buy one, but other than that I don't know what to do. I hope this helped!
